subject: BrightField: Portal ownership recertification & chain-of-custody request
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@brightfield.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightField Security Team <security@brightfield.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Portal ownership recertification & chain-of-custody request

Hi Lukas / Markus,

We're starting BrightField's vendor revalidation for our upcoming SOC 2 readiness window (audit window: Aug 2027). As part of the revalidation we need an updated CAIQ export, a short statement of custody for the artifacts you maintain in the portal (Who has upload rights? where are files stored? presign policy?), and a manifest of attachments for one representative upload.

Specifically we need:
- CAIQ matrix (exported answers + timestamps)
- Evidence manifest CSV for the last 90 days (filename, s3 key, signer)
- A short description of your presign/S3 upload process and TTL on pre-signed URLs
- Confirmation of the current profile stewards and backup stewards (names + emails)

I've attached our CAIQ worksheet and a sample manifest to show the expected format. Can you confirm whether you can provide this by EOD Tue Apr 20? If not, what date works (we're flexible but need runway into May for follow-ups).

Also: if you prefer, we can run a 20–30 minute screen walk and capture a short video of the portal owner flow to speed validation.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Vendor Risk Manager, BrightField Analytics
Olivia Grant | brightfield.ai

Attachments:
- brightfield_caiq_questions_2027.xlsx (xlsx)
- evidence_manifest_sample.csv (csv)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal ownership recertification & chain-of-custody request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the templates. We can meet your timeline for a first pass export, but there are a couple of clarifications so we deliver exactly what your auditor expects: 

Quick clarifications: 
- When you say "manifest of attachments for one representative upload" — do you need the object ACL / presign TTL record (our portal stores presign TTL in the upload audit row) or is filename + s3 key + uploader sufficient?
- For CAIQ, we have both the portal-level Q&A export (answers/timestamps) and a model-level mapping we maintain in the Redaction/Model registry. Do you want both?

Planned deliverables (we can provide by Tue Apr 20 EOD):
- Portal CAIQ export (CSV with timestamped answers)
- Evidence manifest (CSV) that includes presign TTL and uploader email for the representative window
- Short custody statement (one page) listing stewards and their backup contacts, along with who holds KMS access for uploaded evidence (we will not include KMS keys themselves)
- A 15–20 minute recorded walkthrough if you'd like — happy to do live + record.

I'll pull Jordan in on the presign/TLS details and copy Markus for steward confirmation.

Proposed time for a quick sync: Wed Apr 19 10:00–10:30 PDT or Wed Apr 19 14:00–14:30 PDT. Let me know which works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Trust & Safety Operations | Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-19T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal ownership recertification & chain-of-custody request (internal)

Looping in a short internal plan so we stay tight on the deliverable window. Lukas — I'll take steward list confirmation and reconcile names in the portal. Jordan — can you extract the presign audit rows for April (first half) and add the presign TTL column to the manifest? Priyom — can you run the CAIQ export from the Portal > Admin > Exports and verify the timestamp format (UTC vs local) — BrightField expects ISO-8601 UTC.

Internal checklist (owners):
- steward list + contacts (Markus) — due: 2027-04-19 EOD
- presign audit extraction + TTL column (Jordan) — due: 2027-04-19 5pm PDT
- CAIQ portal export + QA (Priyom) — due: 2027-04-19 3pm PDT
- custody statement draft (Lukas) — due: 2027-04-20 12pm PDT

If anyone hits blockers we escalate to the SOC2 PM. We'll attach the small sample manifest and the CAIQ CSV in the single package to send to BrightField.

-Markus

(Internal note: keep the extracted manifest minimal — auditors don't need PII beyond uploader email; redact token IDs.)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@brightfield.ai>

Hi Olivia — thanks, we've completed the package and scheduled a short sync. Deliverables attached and summary below.

Deliverables (attached):
- CAIQ_export_20270419.csv (portal answers, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps)
- evidence_manifest_20270401-20270415.csv (filename, s3_key, uploader_email, presign_ttl_seconds, uploaded_at_utc)
- custody_statement_redwood_20270420.pdf (short steward list + KMS-holder note)

Meeting: Wed Apr 21 10:00 PDT — calendar invite sent to all.

Notes / callouts:

- We redacted transient token IDs and any object contents — only filenames and s3 keys are in the manifest.
- HubSpot deal: HS-3241 (added the doc links in the related_links field).

Please confirm receipt and whether the record format meets your auditor's requirements; if not we will iterate quickly after the sync.

Best regards,
Lukas Meyer
